_about: Hand-picked shows for the Listen shelf. Edit freely: add an Apple Podcasts id, a group, a one-line why. noFeed: true links the show without reading its feed (for publishers whose terms want a licence, like the BBC). scripts/build-shelf.mjs fills in the feed, the latest episodes and the episode count every day. Groups: quiet, stories, learn, start. noArt: Apple ids whose covers are never fetched or published (a show that asked us to stop), so they show initials.

shows.why: Two comedians chatting while they actually run. Company that never needs a reply.
Calm and kind. Deena Kastor and Martin Yelling on the mind as much as the miles.
One runner, alone, thinking out loud. Since 2005.
Warm one-to-one conversations with runners of every level. Never a lecture.
Survival and adventure stories for long runs. Not only about running.
People who became runners late, often through something hard. From the BBC.
One runner's story per episode, told without hurry.
Honest talk about anxiety, burnout and running.
Long, thoughtful conversations that started from an ultra runner's own story.
Everyday runners with real lives. Warm, a little chattier.
Trail and ultra runners on why they go far and quiet.
Runner's World UK's own show. Reliable and weekly.
Runner's World US, with stories from the magazine.
Science-minded coaches who are kind about rest and play.
Evidence first, hype last. Good on shoes and myths.
Practical answers for a first marathon.
Clear, short answers on injuries, form and getting started.
Plain explanations of the words new runners feel silly asking about.
